newsitem.title: GERMANY: Naked radio fans raise temperatures in icy Germany.
newsitem.headline: Naked radio fans raise temperatures in icy Germany.

text.p: About 20 radio fans raised temperatures in ice-bound Munich by running through the city wearing little or nothing in the hope of getting a free holiday.

An independent radio station offered flight tickets on Wednesday to fans who claimed them from the station's roving reporter. It told listeners that whoever was wearing least had the best chance of winning.

Swiss student Fabian Kummer claimed the top prize of a trip to Malaysia by stripping competely naked with the air temperature at minus six degrees Celsius. A German student in undershorts and his topless girlfriend won a trip to Crete.
"We expected to see people in t-shirts, not stark naked," said radio reporter Guido Heuber. "I just saw a tide of flesh bearing down on me."
Police said they had received a flurry of complaints from irate members of the public, but saw no reason to act. "We don't want to spoil people's fun," a spokesman said.
